paragraph: I really hope one of us gets the **award**. Looks as if she's going to win an **award**. The album was long-listed for a music **award**.
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مكافأة

paragraph: The **image** of my mother is on my mind. Could you explain to me what this **image** means? The baby was the very **image** of his mother.
english: a visual or other representation of the external form of something in art

paragraph: He stood in the **middle** of the room. A broken-down car was standing in the **middle** of the road. Why do they have those trees planted in the **middle** of the parking lot?
arabicDesc: مثال: وقف وسط الغرفة.

paragraph: Where did he come up with that **stuff**? I have some **stuff** to do at home. Why did she buy all this **stuff**?
english: things in general, when you do not need to name them
arabicDesc: مثال: من أين ابتكر هذا؟

paragraph: He managed to **cross** the river. She joined the Red **Cross**. When was the last time you **crossed** a river?
arabicDesc: مثال: استطاع أن يعبر النهر.

other.meaning: To make or form a cross (verb)

paragraph: She is a **British** citizen, but she was born in France. He is a **British** teacher who teaches us English. The **British** started to attack from across the river.
arabicDesc: مثال: إنها مواطنة بريطانية و لكن بلدها الأم فرنسا.

paragraph: I'm **sorry**. I won't do it ever again. I'm **sorry** I couldn't get to you sooner. I'm **sorry**, but I can't hear you well.
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا آسف. لن أعيدها أبدًا.

paragraph: I am **training** with my friends. Why are you **training** your dog to attack people? He has been **training** for the cross country race.
english: action of the verb to train
arabicDesc: مثال: إني أتدرب مع أصدقائي.

paragraph: Do we have the **material** to build all this? I haven't enough **material** to write a book yet. You can also buy reading **material** at the station.
english: of, relating to, or consisting of matter, especially physical

other.meaning: A person, or people collectively, who are qualified or suited for a certain position or activity (noun)

paragraph: Which is heavier, lead or **gold**? We're in need of **gold**. They tried to take control of the **gold** market.
arabicDesc: مثال: أيهما أثقل، الذهب أم الرصاص؟

paragraph: Do you know how to open this **box**? The **box** was so heavy I could not move it. The **box** you're looking for is here.
arabicDesc: مثال: هل تعرف كيف تفتح هذا الصندوق؟

paragraph: This is your **choice** and I must respect it. We had no **choice** but to go there. I had no **choice** but to stay in bed all day.
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا خيارك و عليّ أن أحترمه.

paragraph: Who is the **original** owner of this house? He has a lot of **original** ideas. I need to know what the **original** language is.
arabicDesc: مثال: من هو المالك الأصلي لهذا المنزل؟

paragraph: I **finally** found a pair of shoes that fit. She **finally** found her missing keys. I've **finally** finished writing the report.
arabicDesc: مثال: و أخيرا وجدت حذاءا على مقاسي.

paragraph: I'll start my work on the first of **July**. One day in **July**, we went to the sea. The album will have been completed by next **July**.
english: seventh month of the Gregorian calendar
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: تموز

paragraph: The family is the most important **unit** in society. The second is the **unit** of measure for time. I forgot to turn in the work for this **unit**.
english: oneness, singularity, seen as a component of a whole number

paragraph: The **train** left before they got to the station. That is the fastest **train** in the world. Will we be in time for the **train**?
english: line of connected cars or carriages
arabicDesc: مثال: غادرالقطار قبل أن يصلوا إلى المحطة.

other.meaning: the elongated back portion of a dress or skirt which drags along the ground
group of animals, vehicles, or people

paragraph: I'm not even going to **attempt** to do that. He gave up his **attempt** once and for all. He passed his driving test on his first **attempt**.

other.meaning: The action of trying at something (noun)

paragraph: I would like to hear your **voice**, too. I cried out to you, hear my **voice**. Where is this **voice** coming from?
arabicDesc: مثال: أودّ سماع صوتك أيضاً.

other.meaning: To give utterance or expression to (verb)

paragraph: What do you **plant** in the garden? Where did you **plant** them? **Plant** trees in your garden.
english: to place in soil or other substrate in order that it may live and grow
arabicDesc: مثال: ماذا تزرع في الحديقة؟

paragraph: The **production** of this car began in the year 1980. A lot of water is used in paper **production**. They are the sound effects artists of this **production**.
english: the act of producing, making or creating something

paragraph: She **applied** for this job. Did you **apply** for a job in this company? There are some cases where this rule doesn't **apply**.
arabicDesc: مثال: طلبت هذا العمل.

other.meaning: to lay or place; to put (one thing to another)

paragraph: Stop or I'll **pull** the car over! I don't think that we can **pull** that off. Don't try to **pull** a fast one on me!
english: to apply a force to (an object) so that it comes toward the person or thing applying the force
arabicDesc: مثال: توقف وإلا سأسحب السيارة اكثر.

paragraph: Building a wall here is against the building **code**. Adding comments makes it easier to read the **code**. The place where I work has a dress **code**.
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: ترميز، شفرة

other.meaning: set of rules for converting information
system of principles, rules or regulations

paragraph: Suffering from hair **loss** at her age is so sad. I'm at a **loss** for words. The **loss** must be made up for next month.
english: the result of no longer possessing an object, a function, or a characteristic due to external causes or misplacement
arabicDesc: مثال: كان تساقط الشّعر في ذلك السّنّ أمرا محزنا بالنّسبة لها.

other.meaning: destruction or ruin of an object

paragraph: Were you **reading** a book at that time? Do you think this book is worth **reading**? I had been **reading** for an hour.
arabicDesc: مثال: أكنت تقرأ كتاباً في ذلك الوقت؟

paragraph: You said you were **alone**, did you not? This is something I need to do **alone**. I'm sad because everyone went away and left me **alone**.
arabicDesc: مثال: قلت أني كنت وحيدا، أليس كذلك؟

paragraph: It is **certain** that he helped them for his own benefit. I'm still not **certain** what I should be doing. I wish I knew for **certain** what it was.
arabicDesc: مثال: مؤكّدٌ أنه ساعدهم لمنفعة شخصية.

other.meaning: Having been determined but not specified (determiner)

paragraph: The sun sets in the west and rises in the **east**. I heard that he left town and moved **east**. If you face north, the **east** is on your right.
arabicDesc: مثال: تغرب الشمس في الغرب وتشرق من الشرق.

other.meaning: Situated or lying in or towards the east (adjective)
Any of various particular regions named for the cardinal direction in which they lie (noun)

paragraph: The samples were collected from two hundred **medical** institutions all over the world. People are born with all sorts of **medical** conditions. She's feeling much better thanks to that **medical** treatment.
arabicDesc: مثال: جُمِعت العيناتُ من مائتي مؤسسة طبية في جميع أنحاء العالم.

paragraph: Does he know where those cats hid **themselves**? They should have the right to decide for **themselves**. Party members are not allowed to vote for **themselves**.
english: used when the people who do something are also affected by it
arabicDesc: مثال: هل يعلم أين اختبأت تلك القطط؟

paragraph: I won't give up because I have something **worth** fighting for. This movie is **worth** seeing again. Forget it. It's not **worth** it.
arabicDesc: مثال: لن أستسلم لأني لدي شيء يستحق أن أكافح من أجله.

paragraph: That kind of person will **fail** for sure. Don't give up if you **fail**. Study hard so you don't **fail**.
arabicDesc: مثال: إنسان من ذلك النوع سيفشل بالتأكيد.

other.meaning: to receive one or more non-passing grades in academic pursuits

paragraph: I do **wonder** - why is he late? I **wonder** which way is the shortest. I **wonder** where my sisters are now.
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا أتعجب لماذا تأخر؟!

paragraph: I like the color **green**. When the light is **green**, you can keep going. In those days, our parents ate **green** and black.
english: the color of grass and leaves
arabicDesc: مثال: أحب اللون الأخضر.

paragraph: Could you **lower** the volume of the television? If you **lower** the price, I might buy it. Can't you go a bit **lower** on the price?
arabicDesc: مثال: هلّا أخفضت صوت التلفاز؟

other.meaning: To let descend by its own weight, as something suspended (verb)

paragraph: What kind of **technology** do you have at home? I'm a little out of touch with new **technology**. Good use of **technology** can improve our daily life.
english: the study of or a collection of techniques
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: تكنولوجيا، تقانة، تكنيك

paragraph: She found a **ball** in the garden. He threw the **ball** to me. Does he have a **ball**?
arabicDesc: مثال: وجدت طابة في الحديقة.

paragraph: This is a work that **benefits** others. Does doing things in this way have a **benefit**? How does it **benefit** a person to be beautiful?
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا عمل ينفع الآخرين.

paragraph: Our team is the worst team in the **league**. The **League** of Nations did not make for peace. Our team has topped the **league** this season.
english: a group or association of cooperating members
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: اتحاد، اتفاق

paragraph: I hear that the **network** is very popular now. Their job is to connect the computers to the **network**. **Network** television hires the worst writers on earth.
I've been looking **forward** to this all week. I'm looking **forward** to seeing you in your wedding dress. I'm looking **forward** to working with you.
english: at, near or towards the front of something
arabicDesc: مثال: كنت أتطلع لهذا طوال الأسبوع.

other.meaning: An umbrella term for a centre or winger in ice hockey (noun)

paragraph: This is going to take some **effort**. Nothing is achieved without **effort**. Obviously I agree that you should advance in life through your own **efforts**.
english: the amount of work involved in achieving something
arabicDesc: مثال: سيحتاج ذلك لبعض الجهد.

paragraph: I looked for my **cup**, but didn't find it. I want to have a **cup** of coffee. Bring me a **cup** of coffee, will you?
arabicDesc: مثال: بحثت عن فنجاني و لم أجده.

paragraph: Did you receive the **message** I sent you yesterday? I have a **message** for you from her. Please leave a **message** on my answering machine.
arabicDesc: مثال: هل إستلمتَ الرسالة التي أرسلتها لكَ بالأمس؟

paragraph: The police had all the **evidence** they needed. He was trying to destroy **evidence**. I don't have any **evidence**.
english: facts or observations presented in support of an assertion
arabicDesc: مثال: كانت عند الشّرطة كلّ الأدلّة التّي كانت بحاجة إليها.

paragraph: I promise I will **protect** you. He's here to **protect** you. I'm responsible for **protecting** her.
arabicDesc: مثال: أعدك بأن أحميك.

paragraph: Are you ready to **fly**? Not all birds can **fly**. I will **fly** to Germany.
arabicDesc: مثال: هل أنت مستعد أن تطير؟

paragraph: He did **exactly** what I told him to do. I don't know **exactly** when I will be back. I don't know **exactly** what I'm looking for.
arabicDesc: مثال: فعل ما طلبت منه تماماً.

paragraph: School starts in **September** in Europe. A year ago today was the first of **September**. He got into this school in **September** last year.
english: ninth month of the Gregorian calendar
arabicDesc: مثال: تبدأ الدراسة في أوروبا شهر سبتمبر.

paragraph: They **usually** go to school from Monday to Friday. How many days do you **usually** need to get there? What time do you **usually** go to bed?
arabicDesc: مثال: عادةً ما يذهبون إلى المدرسة من الاثنين الى الجمعة.

paragraph: The section **chief** seems to like abusing his authority. What's the name of the new **Chief** of Police? Our **chief** concern should be the aging of society.
arabicDesc: مثال: يبدو أن رئيس القسم يحب استغلال سلطته.

paragraph: The **quality** of higher education must meet international standards. We make our products as best **quality** as possible. I'm not pleased with the **quality** of your work.
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: نوعية

paragraph: He saved the child at the **risk** of his own life. They went on fighting the fire at the **risk** of their lives. If I do that, I **risk** losing a lot.
arabicDesc: مثال: أنقذ الطفل بالمجازفة بحياته.

paragraph: Do not **accept** the world as it is. I hope that you will **accept** my request. I **accept**, but only on one condition.
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تقبل بالعالم كما هو.

other.meaning: to admit to a place or a group

paragraph: A good teacher must be **patient** with his students. Is she a **patient** here? You have to be **patient**.
english: not losing one's temper while waiting
arabicDesc: مثال: المعلم الجيد يجب ان يكون صبورا مع طلابه.

other.meaning: The noun or noun phrase that is semantically on the receiving end of a verb's action (noun)

paragraph: Did you **draw** this yourself? Where did you **draw** them? Why are you **drawing** flowers?
arabicDesc: مثال: هل رسمت هذه بنفسك؟

other.meaning: to extract a liquid, or cause a liquid to come out
That which draws: that which attracts e.g. a crowd (noun)

paragraph: What lives under a **rock**? The fish is hiding under the **rocks**. He fell and hit his head on a **rock**.
arabicDesc: مثال: ماذا يعيش تحت صخرة؟

paragraph: They have us out-**gunned**, but we'll have the element of surprise. I heard that Tom was **gunned** down. Tom was **gunned** down in the street.
english: a device operated by a trigger and acting in a manner similar to a firearm
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: طبنجة، مسدسة

paragraph: I always watch my films in the original **version**. Have you heard the original **version** of this song? I want to hear your **version** of what happened.
english: a specific form or variation of something

other.meaning: a translation from one language to another

paragraph: I think that **Mom** might be having an affair. Not every woman in this world wishes to be a **mom**. My **mom** doesn't speak English very well.
arabicDesc: مثال: أظنّ أنّ لأمّي علاقة غير شرعيّة.

paragraph: You must **perform** your duty. Their job is to do make-up for **performing** artists. I don't like to **perform** in front of others.
arabicDesc: مثال: عليك أن تقوم بالواجب.

paragraph: Why did you **mention** that? Don't **mention** this to anyone. Did somebody **mention** my name?
english: a speaking or notice of anything, usually in a brief or cursory manner
arabicDesc: مثال: لماذا ذكرت ذلك؟

paragraph: They stood up for the rights of their **nation**. The country appealed to the United **Nations** for help. We need a strong person to lead our **nation**.
arabicDesc: مثال: دافعوا عن حق أمتهم.

paragraph: The school is three **miles** from my house. We still have ten **miles** to go. In half a **mile**, turn left on Main Street.
arabicDesc: مثال: المدرسة على بعد ثلاثة أميال من منزلي.

paragraph: Could you give me a ride to the **station**? This is the **station** I need to get off at. Can you tell me how to get to the **station**?
english: place where a vehicle may stop
arabicDesc: مثال: هل يمكنك إيصالي إلى المحطة؟

paragraph: This is the **hospital** which I was born in. Do I have to stay in the **hospital**? I had a grand opening for the **hospital** last month.
english: a building where sick or injured people are treated
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه هي المستشفى التي ولدت فيها.

paragraph: I will do **whatever** I can for you. **Whatever** you say will set her off crying. You can say **whatever** you want to.
english: regardless of the … that; for any … that
arabicDesc: مثال: سافعل كل ما استطيعة من اجلك

paragraph: The **Lord** gave and the **Lord** has taken. This is what the **Lord** says. The **Lord** has looked after me along the way.
arabicDesc: مثال: الرَّبُّ أَعْطَى وَالرَّبُّ أَخَذَ.

other.meaning: The Abrahamic deity of the Jewish, Christian, and Islamic faiths (noun)

paragraph: The river is too **deep**. The lake is very **deep**. The lake is **deepest** at this point.
arabicDesc: مثال: النهر عميق للغاية.

paragraph: He knows the **challenges** of the road. This became the biggest **challenges**. To understand the risks is to accept the **challenge**.
english: that which encourages someone to do something they otherwise would not
arabicDesc: مثال: هو يعرف مخاطر الطريق.

paragraph: I like the way you **treat** me. I'm not used to being **treated** like that. He is a lawyer and must be **treated** as such.
english: to negotiate, discuss terms, bargain (for or with)
arabicDesc: مثال: أحب معاملتك لي.

paragraph: What is the poorest country in the European **Union**? The workers **union** called off their 24-hour strike today. Marriage is the **union** of a man and woman.
english: the act of uniting or the state of being united
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: اتفاق

paragraph: His **dream** was to do a movie. I hope my **dream** will come true. While I was sleeping I saw in a **dream** some people.
arabicDesc: مثال: كان حلمه هو إخراج فيلم.

other.meaning: To see imaginary events in one's mind while sleeping (verb)

paragraph: Please **remove** your shoes before entering the house. Why did you **remove** me? **Remove** damaged posts and replace them with new ones.
arabicDesc: مثال: من فضلك إخلع حذاءك قبل أن تدخل البيت.

paragraph: There is a police station right around the **block**. Have you met the new family on the **block**? The two parties joined forces to **block** the bill.
english: a substantial, often approximately cuboid, piece of any substance

paragraph: I looked all over the house for that **letter**. We need to remember to mail this **letter** tomorrow. I wrote her a **letter** every day.
arabicDesc: مثال: بحثت في المنزل كله عن تلك الرسالة.

paragraph: We waited for our **daughter** to come to her senses. His **daughter** and my son are good friends. You must be very proud of your **daughter**.
arabicDesc: مثال: انتظرنا ابنتنا حتى استعادت صوابها.

paragraph: You shouldn't **judge** others on how they look. You shouldn't **judge** a person by his appearance. You can't **judge** a person if you don't know him well.
english: to sit in judgment on, pass sentence on
arabicDesc: مثال: يجب أن لا تحكم على الآخرين من مظهرهم.

paragraph: That's the **difference** between you and me. I don't see what **difference** that makes. It makes no **difference** to me whether he joins us or not.
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا هو الفرق بيني وبينك

other.meaning: characteristic of something that makes it different from something else
disagreement or argument about something important
to modify a heraldic emblem so as to distinguish one branch of a house from another (verb)

paragraph: The US **Federal** Reserve has raised interest rates to 1%. Don't make a **federal** case out of it! A new person runs the **federal** bank.
english: pertaining to a league or treaty
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: اتحادي

other.meaning: pertaining to the national government level

paragraph: **Management** wants you gone by the end of the day. The **management** has agreed to have talks with the workers. Workers pulled together and asked the **management** for a raise.
This dress is not going to **fit** me. These shoes don't **fit** my feet. My dress doesn't **fit** anymore!
english: to conform to in size and shape
arabicDesc: مثال: لن يناسبني هذا الفستان.

other.meaning: to make conform in size and shape

paragraph: I asked him if he had **drugged** her. I'm pretty sure my drink was **drugged**. I must have been **drugged**.
english: a substance used to treat an illness, relieve a symptom, or modify a chemical process in the body for a specific purpose

other.meaning: substance used as a medical treatment — see also medicine

paragraph: This book **contains** many pictures. All the languages of the world **contain** foreign words. Words that sound nice always **contain** beautiful images.
arabicDesc: مثال: يحتوي هذا الكتاب على صور كثيرة.

paragraph: I work for an **oil** company. How long would it take to change the **oil**? She put a lot of **oil**, I'm not allowed.
arabicDesc: مثال: أعمل لدى شركة نفط.

paragraph: He didn't **notice** a thing. How could you not **notice**? He didn't **notice** the change.
english: ''(now rare in English)'' to remark upon
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يلاحظ شيئا.

paragraph: There are many black cats hiding under the **bed**. I wanted to stay in **bed** all day. On which **bed** would you like to sleep?
arabicDesc: مثال: هناك كثير من القطط السوداء مختبئة تحت السرير.

other.meaning: the bottom of a lake or other body of water

paragraph: It's not hot in my **region** in the summer. What **region** of the country do you live in? We use this word a lot in our **region**.
english: any considerable and connected part of a space or surface

paragraph: This **animal** is bigger than that one. He knows little about that **animal**. He is eating the **animal**.
english: any member of the kingdom Animalia other than a human
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا الحيوان أكبر من ذاك.

paragraph: The **island** is easy to reach by boat. By whom was the **island** discovered? There are **islands** in the sea.
english: area of land completely surrounded by water
arabicDesc: مثال: من السهل الوصول إلى تلك الجزيرة بالسفينة.

paragraph: I'm going to take you where you'll be **safe**. Nothing great has been achieved by playing it **safe**. Keep the money in a **safe** place.
arabicDesc: مثال: سآخذك إلى مكان آمن.

other.meaning: A box, usually made of metal, in which valuables can be locked for safekeeping (noun)

paragraph: Could you **direct** me to the bus stop? Your questions were too **direct**. This is a **direct** reference to his early works.
arabicDesc: مثال: أيمكنك إرشادي لمحطة الحافلة؟

paragraph: The **lady** is now drinking water. I do not know this **lady**. An old **lady** sang to me.
english: polite term referring to a woman
arabicDesc: مثال: السيدة تشرب الآن ماءا.

other.meaning: title for the wife a lord

paragraph: A good **coach** trains this team. Do you really think I'm not a good **coach**? The **coach** told me I needed to practice harder.
english: a wheeled vehicle, generally pulled by a horse
arabicDesc: مثال: يدرّب الفريق مدرّب جيّد.

paragraph: Sir, you have left your lighter on the **table**. At least let me help with the **table**. I might have left it on the **table**.
arabicDesc: مثال: سيدي، لقد تركت ولاّعتك على الطاولة.

other.meaning: grid of data in rows and columns

paragraph: We won't **approach** the enemy. He **approached** the man and asked him if he could use his phone. The more you **approach** women, the more you'll learn.
english: 1. (intransitive) to come or go near, in place or time
arabicDesc: مثال: لن نقترب من العدو.

other.meaning: An act of drawing near in place or time (noun)

paragraph: Their **central** concern was to have a big car. I work in **Central** Park every morning at six. Is the **central** heating warm enough in the winter?
I have a friend who lives in **England**. What he said about **England** is true. This book was printed in **England**.
english: kingdom in southeastern Britain, one of the constituent countries of the UK
arabicDesc: مثال: لديّ صديق يعيش في إنكلترا.

paragraph: **Hey**, wait a minute. Where do you think you're going? **Hey**, what are you guys talking about? **Hey**, come on! Let me out!
arabicDesc: مثال: انتظر لحظة، إلى أين تظنّ نفسكَ ذاهبًا؟
